key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Toggles mute on all microphones. Empty disables it.

key.name: mute-shortcut
key.description: Mutes all microphones. Empty disables it.

key.name: unmute-shortcut
key.description: Unmutes all microphones. Empty disables it.

key.name: unmute-scope
key.description: 'all': unmute every microphone, and microphones that appear afterwards (hotplug, profile switch) follow the unmute. 'active': unmute only the default (selected) microphone and leave the rest muted. Mute always applies to every microphone.

key.name: remember-state
key.description: When true, the last mute state is restored and enforced at login. When false, every login starts with mute off.

key.name: muted
key.description: Internal: the mute intent, used when remember-state is on.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show a microphone icon in the top bar; clicking it toggles mute.

key.name: show-osd
key.description: Show the microphone OSD when the mute state is changed.
